verdict.rationale: Navan is a travel and expense SaaS platform with AI features (Ava, Navan Edge, an MCP server), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no AI-training opt-out, data-use policy, or training exclusion. MCP authentication and user permissions are access controls, not training-data controls, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
